items.title: GPGI, Inc. Investors Have Until September 14th to Seek Lead Plaintiff Role with Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C.
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against GPGI, Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York on behalf of investors who purchased GPGI Class A common stock between November 3, 2025 and May 6, 2026.
